correctness.rationale: The source supplies the exact configuration and generic uniqueness of the minimal degree-8 unexpected curve. The packaged exact certificate gives rank 44 for the 46-by-45 interpolation matrix at P=[3:5:1], multiplicity exactly 7, and coprime translated degree-7 and degree-8 pieces. Any reducible degree-8 curve with multiplicity 7 at the point must contain a line through that point, contradicting the gcd certificate. Closedness of reducible forms and rank-constant algebraic variation then give generic absolute irreducibility.
